summary: Post-market recap: US equities chopped in a narrow range; the composite risk score held at 44.1 (caution) with the goldilocks regime intact; the score eased 0.63 day-over-day and 0.25 week-over-week. Nvidia earnings were the session's binary event — NVDA closed down 1.04% as the market priced the print early; Memory led at +2.96%, Networking +2.86%, and Quantum Computing lagged at -2.65%. The macro pulse improved at the margin: 10Y real rate 2.38%, 10Y yield 4.70%, VIX 15.45, CPI 3.30%, but payrolls -23.0k revealed a labor crack. Crypto was soft, with BTC -0.42%.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Nvidia earnings binary risk: NVDA closed down 1.04%; post-print guidance and AI demand expectations set the near-term path, with valuation at a high-sensitivity zone.
Extreme breadth divergence: only 1.94% of stocks hit 52-week highs while 64.52% trade above their 200-day moving average — new-high and MA breadth diverge.
Macro stays restrictive: the 10Y real rate 2.38% and 10Y yield 4.70% sit at 5-year high percentiles and are the largest single macro contribution to the risk score.
Labor crack widening: payrolls -23.0k (prior +20.0k), unemployment 4.1%, diverging from cooling inflation (CPI 3.30%).

supporting_signals.claim: Mild risk appetite: the VIX fell to 15.45 and the volatility dimension risk score is just 21.92, the lowest of the 6 dimensions.
Rates eased at the margin: the 10Y real rate 2.38% (prior 2.40%) and CPI 3.30% (prior 3.46%) — cooling inflation underpins valuations.
Constructive theme rotation: 13 of 22 sectors closed higher, led by Memory +2.96%, Networking +2.86%, and Industrial Automation +1.70%.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit and rates diverge: HY OAS 2.70 (prior 2.69) widened and reverse repo 0.702 rose above 0.405, thinning liquidity buffers, yet the 10Y yield stays elevated at 4.70%.
Cross-asset confirmation is only 0.625, and the dollar index 118.06 is still triggered (>105), so risk-appetite signals are internally inconsistent.

what_changed_today: The composite risk score is 44.1, down 0.63 day-over-day and 0.25 week-over-week, falling for a second session.
Nvidia reported after the close; shares fell 1.04% on the day, with the AI-semiconductor chain split (MU +0.84%, AMD +0.62%, AVGO -0.87%).
The VIX fell to 15.45 (prior 15.85) and the volatility dimension risk score 21.92 is the lowest across all dimensions.
watch_next: Nvidia's after-close guidance and AI-capital-expenditure commentary set the direction for semis and the compute chain tomorrow.
Later this week watch BILI and NIO earnings, plus macro prints such as Personal Income and Outlays and GDP.
Watch whether the dollar index 118.06 and HY OAS 2.70 stay triggered as a credit and liquidity lead.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the macro soft-landing continues
points: If the 10Y real rate holds below 2.38% and CPI 3.30% keeps cooling, the valuation overhang eases.
Memory and Networking lead (Memory +2.96%, Networking +2.86%), and theme breadth supports risk appetite.

base_case.title: Base case: choppy range within the caution band
points: The score 44.1 sits in the caution band; the goldilocks regime persists but breadth is split (new highs 1.94%, above MA200 64.52%).
Nvidia earnings are a short-term vol source, but cooling macro and low vol (VIX 15.45) cap the downside.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the labor crack triggers recession pricing
points: If payrolls -23.0k persist and unemployment 4.1% rises, the market reprices a growth slowdown, hitting richly-valued semis (NVDA -1.04%) first.
A persistently triggered dollar index 118.06 and widening HY OAS 2.70 transmit credit and liquidity stress to risk assets.
